intro.title: Claude Code — Crucible
lines: This launches an interactive Claude Code session inside the Crucible project folder (C:\cloudflare_projects\crucible).

To make changes, just chat in plain English — for example: "add a settings page" or "fix the bug where the form won't submit". Claude Code reads the code, makes the edits, and can run and test the app for you.
It can create, edit, and delete files and run commands in this folder, so review its proposed changes as you go.
Click OK to drop straight into Claude Code.
